# Stripe or a merchant of record: what do you actually keep?

> Enter your monthly software revenue and average sale price and see what Stripe, Stripe Tax, Paddle, Lemon Squeezy and Polar take, your net payout, 12-month totals, and the revenue where running Stripe yourself beats a merchant of record. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
